With rdflib and lxml installed, it asserted that `get` returned something other than None for each of `json`, `provn`, `rdf`, `xml` and `jsonld`. test_extras.py::test_get_serializer_returns_class_for_each_known_format takes over, because it calls the same `get` for the same five formats and asserts the exact class, which implies the removed `is not None`, and it has no skip guard, so it runs in every job that ran this test (the minimal-install job skipped this test, so nothing is lost there). Planted faults in `Registry.load_serializers` (no `xml` entry, `jsonld` mapped to None, no `provn` entry) failed this test, and with it deselected they failed the takeover. test_public_api.py::test_serializer_registry_formats is a second catcher, because it asserts a `Serializer` subclass for the same five formats and failed under each of those three faults.
